svg.aria-label: The notebook's lines for the heads, with handwritten notes. q = q.view(B, T, self.n_head, self.head_dim) cuts each 128 numbers into 4 pieces of 32, because n_head is 4 and head_dim is 32. q = q.transpose(1, 2) regroups the pieces by head, so all four heads run side by side, at once. The same is done to the keys and values. After collecting, out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, T, C) lays the four heads' 32 numbers side by side, 128 again, and self.proj, one more table of weights, mixes what the four heads found.
svg.text: The heads, in the notebook's Python
From CausalSelfAttention.forward (cell 1.2); the handwritten notes are my own reading
